name: Chainsaw Operation
description: Timed quiz on OSM Specialist Chainsaw Operation knowledge — safety features, kickback, PPE and correct procedure.

questions.description: What is the correct approved location for a cold start versus a warm (hot) start on a chainsaw?
options: Cold start on the ground, warm start between the legs
Cold start between the legs, warm start on the ground
Both cold and warm start on the ground
Both cold and warm start between the legs
questions.correctAnswer: Cold start on the ground, warm start between the legs

questions.description: Can a chainsaw be used above shoulder height?

options: Contact with the upper quadrant of the bar/chain tip
questions.correctAnswer: Contact with the upper quadrant of the bar/chain tip
